adventure.title: Hike the Grandview Rim Trail
adventure.description: Walk the ridgeline connecting Grandview's overlooks, ducking through rhododendron thickets between sweeping views of the river's horseshoe bend.
adventure.bonus: Count how many overlooks you hit before turning back.

adventure.title: Navigate the ACE Aerial Adventure Park Ropes Course
adventure.description: Self-belay across elevated bridges and obstacles through the treetops, then finish with a free-fall leap off the highest platform.
adventure.bonus: Take the highest jump platform, no hesitating.

adventure.title: Play a Round of Disc Golf at Wolf Creek Park
adventure.description: Throw a wooded, elevation-heavy course tucked into Fayetteville's Wolf Creek Park trail system.
adventure.bonus: Call your shot before you throw it.

adventure.title: Learn to Climb with New River Mountain Guides
adventure.description: Rope up on Nuttall sandstone with an AMGA-certified guide who puts you on real routes your first afternoon, no experience required.
adventure.bonus: Top out on one route without asking for beta.

adventure.title: Paddle Summersville Lake by Kayak or SUP
adventure.description: Rent a kayak or paddleboard and explore sandstone cliff lines and clear coves on West Virginia's largest lake.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to a cliff line and just float for a while.

adventure.title: Take the Full Moon Bridge Walk Tour
adventure.description: Cross the same 851-foot-high catwalk after dark, watching moonrise wash over the gorge with nothing but a guide's flashlight and the river below.
adventure.bonus: Turn off your headlamp for sixty seconds and just listen.

adventure.title: Scuba Dive the Clear Water of Summersville Lake
adventure.description: Drop beneath one of the clearest freshwater lakes east of the Mississippi with Sarge's Dive Shop, diving May through September when summer visibility stretches past 40 feet.
adventure.bonus: Find something underwater you can't identify and ask about it topside.

adventure.title: Trail Ride with Horseshoe Creek Stables
adventure.description: Ride through wildflower fields and rushing streams on a guided horseback trail ride through the New River Gorge backcountry.
adventure.bonus: Learn your horse's name and use it the whole ride.

adventure.title: Zip the Gorgeside Canopy Tour at ACE Adventure Resort
adventure.description: Race a friend side-by-side across nine ziplines and two sky bridges, including a 680-foot line a hundred feet above the forest floor.
adventure.bonus: Race whoever's next to you on the last line.

adventure.title: Hike the Endless Wall Trail to Diamond Point
adventure.description: Follow the cliff edge two miles above the gorge to Diamond Point, where the Nuttall sandstone drops clean away beneath your boots.
adventure.bonus: Spot a climber on the wall below you.

adventure.title: Hike Long Point Trail to the Bridge View
adventure.description: Push through rhododendron tunnels to Long Point's exposed rock outcrop, the single best angle on the New River Gorge Bridge from the ground.
adventure.bonus: Get a photo with the whole bridge in frame.

adventure.title: Run the Lower New River with Adventures on the Gorge
adventure.description: Charge through Class IV–V monsters like Miller's Folly and Double Z on a guided Lower New River run, the gorge's biggest whitewater from April through October.
adventure.bonus: Ride the biggest rapid in the bow seat.

adventure.title: Descend the 821 Steps of the Kaymoor Miners Trail
adventure.description: Drop nearly 800 feet down a steel staircase into a vanished coal-mining town, where rusted machinery and stone foundations still sit swallowed by forest.
adventure.bonus: Count the steps yourself and see if you get 821.

adventure.title: Rent Bikes and Ride at Arrowhead Bike Farm
adventure.description: Grab a rental mountain bike, roll straight onto the trailhead, and cap the ride with a cold one at the on-site biergarten.
adventure.bonus: High-five the next rider you pass on the trail.

adventure.title: Walk the Catwalk on the New River Gorge Bridge Walk
adventure.description: Clip into a safety cable and cross a 24-inch steel catwalk suspended 851 feet beneath one of the highest bridges in the country.
adventure.bonus: Spot a BASE jump landing zone from the catwalk.

adventure.title: Rappel into the Gorge with ACE Adventure Resort
adventure.description: Back off the edge of a sandstone cliff and lower yourself hundreds of feet into the New River Gorge on a guided rappelling trip.
adventure.bonus: Keep your eyes open for the entire first ten feet.

adventure.title: Watch the BASE Jumpers Leap on Bridge Day
adventure.description: Stand shoulder to shoulder with thousands on the closed-off New River Gorge Bridge every third Saturday in October as daredevils BASE jump 876 feet into the gorge below.
adventure.bonus: Count how many jumpers you see land safely.

adventure.title: Ride the Arrowhead Trails Singletrack
adventure.description: Pedal the stacked-loop Clovis, Adena, and Dalton trails through sandstone singletrack minutes from downtown Fayetteville.
adventure.bonus: Ride the full Dalton loop without stopping to walk.

adventure.title: Chase Class V on the Upper Gauley During Gauley Season
adventure.description: Drop into five Class V rapids in twelve miles on the legendary Upper Gauley, unleashed by dam releases every fall from September to October.
adventure.bonus: Name your raft crew before you launch.

adventure.title: Book a Small-Group Run with Cantrell Ultimate Rafting
adventure.description: Skip the crowds on a boutique New River trip where the guide-to-guest ratio stays tight and the coaching gets personal.
adventure.bonus: Ask your guide for their scariest gorge story.

adventure.title: Float the Family-Friendly Upper New with ACE Adventure Resort
adventure.description: Paddle splashy Class I–III waves and long calm pools on the Upper New, a full-day float built for first-timers and long conversations with new friends.
adventure.bonus: Learn one river-guide term and use it correctly by lunch.

social.title: Pool and Ping Pong in The Freefolk Brewery Game Room
social.description: Challenge the table to pool or ping pong in Freefolk's air-conditioned game room while a fresh pint sweats on the rail.
social.bonus: Play the winner of the next table's game.

social.title: Rally with the Paddling World at Gauley Fest
social.description: Join thousands of boaters at American Whitewater's Gauley Fest, the world's largest whitewater festival, for camping, live music, and river-culture chaos every September.
social.bonus: Trade river stories with a boater from out of state.

social.title: Firepit Hang on the Patio at Bridge Brew Works
social.description: Circle up around the fire pit with a pint and a food truck plate while dogs and kids run the beer garden.
social.bonus: Introduce yourself to the strangers at the next firepit over.

social.title: Catch Sunset Live Music at The Burrito Bar at Breeze Hill
social.description: Grab a table on the multi-level deck as a regional band plays into the sunset over the gorge rim in Lansing.
social.bonus: Request a song from the band between sets.

social.title: Catch a Show at the Historic Fayette Theatre
social.description: Settle into a Depression-era movie house turned community theater for a live production staged by local actors since 1993.
social.bonus: Stick around after the curtain call to meet the cast.

social.title: Round Up the Crew at Southside Junction Tap House
social.description: Claim the corner table with friends and work through the rotating tap list and bar food until the parking lot empties out.
social.bonus: Buy a round for whoever just finished a river trip.

social.title: Ride a Full Moon Paddleboard Tour on Summersville Lake
social.description: Glide across glassy water on an LED-lit paddleboard as the sky flips from sunset pink to full-moon silver on a summer night with Mountain Surf Paddle Sports.
social.bonus: Turn off your board light for one full minute under the moon.

foodie.title: Taco Flight and Rotating Taps at Southside Junction Tap House
foodie.description: Work through a dozen rotating local drafts alongside gouda mac and cheese bites and a build-your-own taco spread on Fayetteville's main corner.
foodie.bonus: Order a tap you've never heard of.

foodie.title: Craft Cocktails at Rosa's Speakeasy
foodie.description: Duck into a hidden 1920s-style bar inside a Queen Anne Victorian for a candlelit cocktail menu built for slow conversation.
foodie.bonus: Let the bartender pick your drink based on your mood.

foodie.title: Flight Tasting on the Patio at Bridge Brew Works
foodie.description: Sample small-batch pours around a fire pit at Fayetteville's own three-person craft brewery, growlers and all.
foodie.bonus: Fill a growler to take back to camp.

foodie.title: Rim-View Steak Dinner at Smokey's on the Gorge
foodie.description: Dig into Appalachian-inspired steak and trout while the gorge falls into shadow just past the porch railing.
foodie.bonus: Ask your server which table has the best gorge view and request it.

foodie.title: Build a Wild Pie at Pies & Pints
foodie.description: Order an unconventional pizza like the Chicken Gouda or Grape & Gorgonzola and pair it with a rotating regional draft.
foodie.bonus: Order the weirdest-sounding pie on the menu.

foodie.title: Brunch Inside a Converted Church at Cathedral Cafe
foodie.description: Order salted caramel lattes and daily specials under stained glass in a 1905 church turned Fayetteville's favorite breakfast spot.
foodie.bonus: Ask what's baked fresh that morning before you order.

foodie.title: Wood-Fired Pizza Night at The Freefolk Brewery
foodie.description: Pair a pint of Trucker Speed IPA with a pie from Ample Pizza in Freefolk's Hico taproom just north of the bridge.
foodie.bonus: Try the flight before committing to a pint.

foodie.title: Sip a Tasting Flight at Kirkwood Winery & Isaiah Morgan Distillery
foodie.description: Work through West Virginia-made wines and small-batch spirits at neighboring tasting rooms just outside Summersville.
foodie.bonus: Pick a bottle to bring back for the group.

chill.title: Cruise Fayette Station Road Under the Bridge
chill.description: Wind down the old switchback road that ducks beneath the New River Gorge Bridge and crosses the river on a low steel span.
chill.bonus: Pull off at the low bridge and look straight up.

chill.title: Watch Sunset from Beauty Mountain's Rams Head Overlook
chill.description: Follow an unmarked ridgeline trail through rhododendron to a west-facing cliff where the gorge glows gold at last light.
chill.bonus: Stay until the first star shows up.

chill.title: Stargaze from the Fayette Station Overlook
chill.description: Post up at a dark-sky pulloff below the bridge deck and watch the Milky Way take over once the last headlights fade.
chill.bonus: Spot a satellite before anyone else in your group does.

chill.title: Browse the Fayette County Farmers Market
chill.description: Wander a Saturday morning lineup of local produce, baked goods, and crafts in downtown Fayetteville, May through October.
chill.bonus: Buy something from a vendor you've never tried before.

chill.title: Walk the Boardwalk to Sandstone Falls
chill.description: Follow an accessible boardwalk to the widest waterfall in the New River Gorge, a 1,500-foot curtain of whitewater near Hinton.
chill.bonus: Find the spot where the falls sound loudest.

chill.title: Picnic at the Grandview Main Overlook
chill.description: Spread a blanket at the platform overlooking a mile-wide horseshoe bend in the New River, once its own state park for good reason.

chill.title: Paddle Out for SUP Yoga on Plum Orchard Lake
chill.description: Balance through a guided yoga flow on a paddleboard anchored in a quiet cove each summer with Mountain Surf Paddle Sports.
chill.bonus: Hold one pose until your board stops wobbling.

chill.title: Take In the Bridge from Canyon Rim Visitor Center Boardwalk
chill.description: Follow the boardwalk from the visitor center to a platform staring straight down the barrel of the New River Gorge Bridge.
chill.bonus: Count the bridge's arches from the lower overlook.
